lesson.title: Talking About Times & Occasions
lesson.subtitle: Once, last time, this time, next time, every time, and again
lesson.description: Learn how 次 (cì) is used to count action occurrences, identify previous, current, and future occasions, express every time and repetition, and choose natural shorter forms in conversation. Includes 一 (yī) tone sandhi.

readings.context: Modern Mandarin measure word for occurrences; also appears in other lexical senses outside this lesson.

intro.lesson_focus: Count occurrences with 次 (cì), identify particular occasions, and express repetition with 再 (zài); six expressions are reported as extracted from one_time.mp4 (14 seconds).
intro.core_principle: Distinguish the character 次 (cì), the counting phrase 一次 (yí cì), temporal expressions such as 上一次 (shàng yí cì), and adverbial repetition such as 再一次 (zài yí cì).
intro.learning_priority: Begin with the six reported video expressions; practice the six constructed sentences; then learn conversational shortenings, frequency complements, and tone sandhi.

overview.core_takeaway: 次 (cì) counts occurrences of actions; 一次 (yí cì) can count one occurrence, while 上一次 (shàng yí cì), 这一次 (zhè yí cì), and 下一次 (xià yí cì) identify particular occasions.
overview.independent_usage: Common as a measure word after a numeral and in occurrence-related phrases; not typically used alone to say “once.”
overview.teaching_priority: high for this beginner lesson (editorial priority, not a measured frequency rank)

meaning_map.function_en: Contribute an occurrence count inside a repetition phrase

overview.one_minute_explanation: After a verb, 一次 (yí cì) answers “how many times?” In expressions like 上一次 (shàng yí cì), 这一次 (zhè yí cì), or 下一次 (xià yí cì), it answers “which occasion?” 再一次 (zài yí cì) generally means “once again.” In all these expressions, 一 (yī) is pronounced yí before the fourth-tone word 次 (cì).

items.usage_note: VIDEO-REPORTED: one of six expressions reported extracted directly from one_time.mp4; after a verb, counts one action occurrence.
VIDEO-REPORTED: previous occasion; often shortened to 上次 (shàng cì) in conversation.
VIDEO-REPORTED: present or contextually relevant occasion; often shortened to 这次 (zhè cì).
VIDEO-REPORTED: following occasion; often shortened to 下次 (xià cì).
VIDEO-REPORTED: each occasion; shorter 每次 (měi cì) is common; often paired with 都 (dōu).
VIDEO-REPORTED: indicates repetition before a verb, distinct from the verb phrase 再来一次 (zài lái yí cì).
SUPPLEMENTARY: shorter everyday alternative to 上一次 (shàng yí cì).
SUPPLEMENTARY: shorter everyday alternative to 这一次 (zhè yí cì).
SUPPLEMENTARY: shorter everyday alternative to 下一次 (xià yí cì).
SUPPLEMENTARY: shorter everyday alternative to 每一次 (měi yí cì).

items.meaning_en: Do it one more time; have another go
items.usage_note: SUPPLEMENTARY: a related verb phrase containing 来 (lái); not a shortening of 再一次 (zài yí cì).

vocabulary.notes: Exactly six expressions (priority A) are identified as extracted from the 14-second video in the reviewed user report. Four shortened alternatives and one related verb phrase (priority B) were added as supplementary learning material. Most are compositional phrases rather than indivisible lexicalized words; the part-of-speech field describes the phrase-level role. Seven component-character vocabulary items appear separately in extension ext-components, not as character-shape decomposition.

items.function_en: Count one occurrence of a verb
items.usage_note: 一次 (yí cì) follows the verb and answers “How many times?”; also possible with experience marker 过 (guo).

example.pinyin: Shàng yí cì wǒ méi tīng dǒng
example.meaning_en: Last time I did not understand what I heard

items.usage_note: Often appears at the start of a sentence as a time expression.

example.pinyin: Zhè yí cì wǒ míngbai le

items.usage_note: A sentence-initial temporal phrase; 这次 (zhè cì) is a common shortening.

example.pinyin: Xià yí cì wǒmen yìqǐ qù ba

items.usage_note: A sentence-initial temporal phrase; 下次 (xià cì) is common in speech.

items.function_en: Apply a statement to each occurrence

example.hanzi: 每一次见到你，我都很开心
example.pinyin: Měi yí cì jiàn dào nǐ, wǒ dōu hěn kāixīn
example.meaning_en: Every time I see you, I am happy

items.usage_note: 每一次 (měi yí cì) and 都 (dōu) are conventionally paired, but 都 is not universally obligatory.

items.function_en: Express one more repetition before a verb

example.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài yí cì gǎnxiè nǐ
example.meaning_en: I want to thank you once again

items.usage_note: 再一次 (zài yí cì) modifies the verb 感谢 (gǎnxiè).

items.function_en: Ask for or describe one more occurrence
items.usage_note: Compare the postverbal count in 再试一次 (zài shì yí cì) with the preverbal adverbial 再一次 (zài yí cì).

constructions.structural_note: Do not equate a postverbal frequency complement, a temporal noun phrase, a quantified temporal phrase, and a preverbal repetition adverbial. Similar surface vocabulary can fulfill different grammatical slots.

examples.default_provenance: The first six sentences are supplementary, constructed teaching examples supplied in the reviewed report, NOT quotations from one_time.mp4. The seventh is an additional constructed contrast sentence from report section 5.2.

items.title: Once: count an experience
items.pinyin: Wǒ qù guo Běijīng yí cì.
items.teaching_note: 过 (guo) marks experiential aspect, while 一次 (yí cì) counts the occurrence.

items.title: Last time: did not understand
items.pinyin: Shàng yí cì wǒ méi tīng dǒng.
items.english: Last time, I didn’t understand what I heard.
items.context: Reflecting on a previous listening situation.
items.teaching_note: 没听懂 (méi tīng dǒng) indicates failure to achieve understanding by listening.

items.title: This time: understood
items.pinyin: Zhè yí cì wǒ míngbai le.
items.context: Contrasting current comprehension with an earlier occasion.
items.teaching_note: Sentence-final 了 (le) presents a newly attained state of understanding.

items.title: Next time: a suggestion
items.pinyin: Xià yí cì wǒmen yìqǐ qù ba.
items.teaching_note: 吧 (ba) softens the statement into a suggestion.

items.title: Every time: repeated experience
items.hanzi: 每一次见到你，我都很开心。
items.pinyin: Měi yí cì jiàn dào nǐ, wǒ dōu hěn kāixīn.
items.english: Every time I see you, I’m very happy.
items.teaching_note: 每一次 (měi yí cì) and 都 (dōu) form a conventional distributive pattern.

items.title: Once again: gratitude
items.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài yí cì gǎnxiè nǐ.
items.english: I want to thank you once again.
items.teaching_note: 再一次 (zài yí cì) modifies 感谢 (gǎnxiè) and expresses repetition.

items.title: Extra illustration: a particular occasion
items.pinyin: Shàng yí cì wǒ qù le Běijīng.
items.english: Last time, I went to Beijing.
items.context: Contrasts identifying an occasion with counting occurrences.
items.teaching_note: 上一次 (shàng yí cì) identifies the occasion; compare 我去过北京一次 (Wǒ qù guo Běijīng yí cì), which counts occurrences.

items.usage: Shorter form of 上一次 (shàng yí cì), often conversational.
items.limitation: Longer form can give emphasis to a specific occasion, not a different grammatical meaning.

items.usage: Shorter form of 这一次 (zhè yí cì), often conversational.
items.limitation: Shortened expressions are not obligatory; full forms are correct.

items.usage: Shorter form of 下一次 (xià yí cì), often conversational.
items.limitation: Both are natural; longer expression can be emphatic.

items.usage: Shorter form of 每一次 (měi yí cì), often conversational.
items.limitation: This is not a one-occurrence frequency complement when used as a temporal phrase.

items.usage: Adverb indicating repetition, often before a verb.
items.limitation: Not identical to 在 (zài), despite identical pronunciation.

items.usage: Marks location or an ongoing action in this example.

items.incorrect_inference: Treat 去一次 (qù yí cì) and 上一次 (shàng yí cì) as the same syntactic structure.
items.correction: Identify the slot: after a verb, 一次 (yí cì) counts how many times; before a clause, 上一次 (shàng yí cì) can identify when.
items.reason: One is a frequency complement; the other is a temporal noun phrase.

items.incorrect_inference: Write the contextual pronunciation of 一次 as yī cì in tone-marked learning examples.
items.correction: Write 一次 (yí cì) when teaching its ordinary spoken pronunciation; retain 一 (yī) as the dictionary reading of the individual character.
items.reason: 一 (yī) becomes yí before fourth tone 次 (cì).

items.incorrect_inference: Confuse 再 (zài, again) and 在 (zài, at/in or ongoing action).
items.correction: Use 再试一次 (zài shì yí cì) for “try again” and 我在学习 (Wǒ zài xuéxí) for “I am studying”.
items.reason: They are homophones with different grammatical functions.

items.incorrect_inference: Assume 上一次 (shàng yí cì) is incorrect because speakers often say 上次 (shàng cì).
items.correction: Both are correct; the shorter alternative is especially common in conversation.
items.reason: The longer variant can emphasize one particular occasion.

items.incorrect_inference: Treat 都 (dōu) as mandatory after every use of 每一次 (měi yí cì).
items.correction: Learn 每……都…… (měi ... dōu ...) as a highly conventional pattern, not an absolute requirement.
items.reason: Other syntactic configurations are also possible.

items.incorrect_inference: Describe 再来一次 (zài lái yí cì) as a shortened form of 再一次 (zài yí cì).
items.correction: Teach it as a related verb phrase with 来 (lái), not a shortening.
items.reason: The form and syntactic structure are different.

questions.prompt: In 我去过北京一次 (Wǒ qù guo Běijīng yí cì), does 一次 (yí cì) answer “how many times” or “which occasion”?
questions.explanation: 一次 (yí cì) is a postverbal frequency complement.

questions.prompt: Choose the common shorter form of 下一次 (xià yí cì).
questions.explanation: The initial 下 (xià) marks the following occasion.

questions.prompt: Why is 一次 (yí cì) written with yí rather than yī in contextual pinyin?
questions.answer: Because 次 (cì) has fourth tone, which normally changes 一 (yī) to yí.
questions.explanation: Distinguish dictionary pronunciation from contextual tone sandhi.

questions.prompt: Which expression means “try one more time”?
questions.answer: 再试一次 (zài shì yí cì).
questions.explanation: Use 再 (zài) for repetition rather than 在 (zài).

questions.prompt: Say “Every time I see you, I’m very happy” using 每一次 (měi yí cì) and 都 (dōu).
questions.answer: 每一次见到你，我都很开心。(Měi yí cì jiàn dào nǐ, wǒ dōu hěn kāixīn.)
questions.explanation: A temporal every-time phrase and a main clause with 都 (dōu) express recurrence.
